title: DiversePlace: Diversity-Seeking Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Macro Placement
abstract: arXiv:2611.34472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Macro placement is a critical early-stage decision in physical design because macro locations strongly constrain subsequent implementation stages. The task is difficult because these high-impact discrete decisions must be made before downstream quality can be measured accurately, forcing training to rely on fast but imperfect training-time oracles such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). Existing RL-based placers therefore mostly optimize single HPWL-driven solutions, and their long sequential horizons often require heavy search assistance or offline expert data while leaving little room to preserve multiple competitive layouts. We address this gap by making quality-controlled diversity an explicit objective for macro placement. Instead of relying on a single proxy-optimal solution, we maintain a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet meaningfully different placements for downstream selection. translated_title: DiversePlace：面向宏单元布局的多样性探索课程强化学习
translated_abstract: 宏单元布局是物理设计中至关重要的早期决策，因为宏单元的位置会强烈约束后续的实现阶段。这项任务之所以困难，是因为这些高影响力的离散决策必须在下游质量能够被准确评估之前做出，迫使训练只能依赖快速但不完美的训练时代理指标（oracle），例如半周长线长（HPWL）。因此，现有的基于强化学习的布局器大多只优化单一的HPWL驱动解决方案，其较长的序列化决策时程往往需要繁重的搜索辅助或离线专家数据，同时几乎没有保留多个具有竞争力的布局方案的空间。我们通过将质量受控的多样性作为宏单元布局的显式目标来弥补这一空白。我们不依赖单一的代理最优解，而是维护一个紧凑的存档，其中保存了在HPWL上具有竞争力但彼此显著不同的布局方案，供下游选择使用。我们在DiversePlace中实现了这一想法，这是一种课程强化学习方法……
tldr: 该论文提出DiversePlace，一种将质量受控的多样性作为显式目标的课程强化学习方法，通过维护多个HPWL具有竞争力且彼此显著不同的宏单元布局存档，为下游选择提供多样化的高质量方案。
en_tdlr: DiversePlace is a curriculum reinforcement learning approach for macro placement that explicitly optimizes quality-controlled diversity by maintaining a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet distinct layouts for downstream selection.
